>>Why Digital Soccer is Your Venue Transformation Catalyst

Global venue operators of FEC, indoor playground and entertainment centers face common operational headaches：

  • Low repeat‑play rate: Traditional amusement games lose novelty quickly; visitors seldom come back for second time.

  • Revenue‑mode inflexibility: Many devices only support fixed play mode, cannot switch between coin‑operated commercial mode and free‑play training mode for sport clubs.

  • Complex configuration & calibration: Most sports simulators require complicated parameter tuning, consuming staff working hours.

  • Lack of competitive incentive: No built‑in ranking mechanism to stimulate user competition.

Our football training game machine solves these pain points: three distinct game modes keep content fresh; operators can toggle payment function ON/OFF in backend; quick Q‑key one‑touch calibration; built‑in local leaderboard fuels competition and encourages repeat consumption.



>> Product Parameters for the Soccer Simulator:


Game Modes:Penalty Master, High Score Challenge, Action Challenge

Operation Mode:Coin‑operated / Free‑play (switchable in backend setting panel)

Setting Function:Password protection, per‑game coin cost adjustment, coin count modification, game time setting, save & reset

Working Voltage:AC 100‑240V

Display:Virtual stadium scene, real‑time score, remaining balls, countdown timer, post‑game local leaderboard

Built-In Business & Revenue Management System

Designed with venue operators in mind, our secure backend menu gives you total control over your business operations:

  • Customisable Payment Logic: Set custom price-per-play or integrate with digital magnetic card readers.

  • Password-Protected Operator Settings: Prevent unauthorised tampering with secured pricing and hardware controls.

  • Post-Game Analytics & Leaderboards: Displays burnt calories, return heatmaps, and ball speed metrics after every

  • round. Local leaderboard integration drives competitive replayability among customers.

  • Automated Attract Mode: Plays promotional videos during idle periods to attract foot traffic across your venue floor.

>> FAQs for Soccer Simulator:

Q1: What after‑sales support can we get as overseas buyer?

A1: We are Guangzhou direct manufacturer. We supply user manual, remote software debugging guidance, spare‑part supply.

Q2: Can I run this without charging coins or cards?

A2: Yes. The payment system can be close in the settings for free-play events, corporate rentals, or fixed hourly facility access.


Q3: Does this football simulator support multiplayer competition?

A3: It supports single‑player turns, with local device ranking board to compare scores of different players, creating competitive atmosphere for group visitors.


Q4: Is the equipment durable enough for heavy commercial usage?

A4: Yes, the system uses high-precision industrial camera tracking, robust impact screens, and commercial-grade 

ball-dispensing units built for high-volume commercial environments.
